name: Return to MacKinley
label: Quest
description: After the scare of the giblets, "Shaky" Phillipe hands you a pouch to carry to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley. Phillipe swears the debt was always meant to be paid…
intro: After the scare of the giblets, "Shaky" Phillipe hands you a pouch to carry to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley. Phillipe swears the debt was always meant to be paid and adds that there is no need to get rough.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here, take this pouch and give it to Sea Wolf. And tell him I meant to pay him back! I swear!!
I just got a little drunk and lost my way, and...you know how things are. He'll understand - you don't have to get rough!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Here here, friend. Did you get Shaky's payment?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Heh heh, well done! And when you showed Shaky those giblets, how hard did he shake?
Hah! He's so easy to read, when I play cards with him I can't help but win!
Thanks for your help, friend. Now it's your turn to get paid...
